title: Leftover-Balance Relief at Payoff on Home Comfort Financing Promotional Plans
content:
**Clause.** The payoff leftover relief on a Home Comfort Financing account applies only when the plan's promotion has ended and measures the amount financed less every payment that stood, a payment standing when it was not returned, in units of the account's monthly payment: it is 20 percent when that measure is at most one, 10 percent when it is above one but at most three, and zero when it is above three or the promotion has not ended.

**Definitions.**

- *The promotion has ended* — the plan has a promotional period and the day of payoff is after its promotional end date.
- *Payments that stood* — the total of every payment posted on the account, less the total of every returned payment.
- *The measure* — the amount financed less the payments that stood, divided by the account's monthly payment, unrounded.

| Promotion ended | Measure, in monthly payments | Payoff leftover relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at most 1 | 20 percent |
| yes | above 1, at most 3 | 10 percent |
| yes | above 3 | zero |
| no | any | zero |

The relief is one of the payoff reliefs; together they form the payoff relief percentage by addition, and the starting rate is reduced once by that total — the reliefs never act one after another.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, amount financed $6000.00, monthly payment $333.60)

| Payments that stood | Leftover | Measure | Promotion ended | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $5700.00 | $300.00 | 0.899… | yes | 20 percent |
| $5332.80 | $667.20 | exactly 2 | yes | 10 percent |
| $4000.00 | $2000.00 | 5.995… | yes | zero |
| $5700.00 | $300.00 | 0.899… | no | zero |
